question: Where can I get a list of wind projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: Start with EIA-860M. Its September 2026 Planned sheet had 77 wind generator rows across 71 plants. Only 17 generator rows carried code L (regulatory approvals pending). The file includes capacity, coordinates and planned operation dates. Check the actual permitting stage and date in the relevant agency files, such as BLM, BOEM or New York ORES.
main_caveats: EIA-860M only lists generators reported to or researched by EIA; early-stage and unreported projects can be absent, and capacities are 'preliminary' and silently revised.
EIA status (L, T, P, U, V, TS) is not a permit record: Heritage Wind (NY) shows 'P regulatory approvals not initiated' at 126 MW while ORES lists a permit for 184.8 MW.
BLM 'Completed - Completed' means the NEPA process ended, not that a project stands approved: Lava Ridge has ROD 12/4/2024 and a later DOI statement on cancelling it.
BLM, BOEM and ORES each cover only their jurisdiction (federal land, outer continental shelf, one state); wind on private land with no federal or state siting nexus is not in them.
Queue entries, leases and lease areas (BOEM lease layer: 4,892 block polygons) are leads, not authorisations.
answer.confidence_reason: EIA and BOEM data downloaded/queried; BLM and ORES read from pages and a portal endpoint. Only four jurisdictions checked; other states and the FAST-41 dashboard were not readable.

attributes.note: EIA planned wind rows all carry lat/long (77/77, plant point); BOEM gives lease/phase polygons; BLM a project point on some rows (15 of 32 wind-named).
EIA nameplate MW per generator row (sum by plant); BOEM/BLM/ORES give MW only in project text and it can differ (Revolution Wind 704 vs 715).
BLM 'Applicant', BOEM DEVELOPER_NAME and ORES text name the applicant; EIA gives only 'Entity Name' (owner/operator entity), not a developer field.
attributes.gap_note: EIA-860M has no developer field; only agency records name the applicant, project by project.

attributes.note: EIA has a survey code per generator. Code L flags pending approvals. Verify the stage, date and scope in the relevant BLM, BOEM or state records.
attributes.gap_note: Other state siting bodies and county permits were not opened (CA, TX, WY, IL, MN, etc.); no single national documented-stage list found.

attributes.note: Dates for a stage appear on BLM project pages (e.g. ROD 12/4/2024) and BOEM project pages (COP approval 2023-11-17); EIA and the ORES list give none.
attributes.gap_note: BLM/DMM document tables with release and filing dates load by script and were not retrieved; EIA gives only planned operation month/year, not a stage date.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o september_generator2026.xlsx 'https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/archive/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx' ; open sheet 'Planned' (header on row 3) and keep rows where 'Energy Source Code' = 'WND'
how_to_use.example_result: Entity Name 'Orsted Wind Power North America LLC'; Plant Name 'Revolution Wind'; RI, Washington; 715 MW; 'Offshore Wind Turbine'; Status '(V) Under construction, more than 50 percent complete'; planned operation 11/2026; lat 41.15217, lon -71.07783.
steps: Download the latest monthly workbook from the landing page; use GET (a HEAD request returned 503) and only months already released (October-December 2026 links redirect to /electricity/).

Read sheet 'Planned' from row 3 (row 1 title, row 2 blank); filter 'Energy Source Code' = 'WND'. In the 2026-09 file this gives 77 rows (73 onshore, 4 offshore), about 23,543 MW, 71 distinct plants. Seventeen rows report status L (approvals pending).
Sum 'Nameplate Capacity (MW)' by Entity ID + Plant ID to get project MW; keep the Status code to separate pending approvals (L, P) from approved (T) and under construction (U, V, TS).
For withdrawn or postponed projects read sheet 'Canceled or Postponed' (156 wind rows, about 19,102 MW; no status, date or reason columns).
Confirm any project in an agency record (BLM, BOEM, state siting body) before calling it permitted.
reading_traps: Status codes come from EIA's survey, not from a permit register: Heritage Wind (NY) is '(P) regulatory approvals not initiated' at 126 MW while ORES lists a permit for a 184.8 MW project of the same name.
No stage date exists; 'Planned Operation Month/Year' is the expected in-service date.

One project can span several rows and statuses: 'Chokecherry and Sierra Madre Wind' (WY) has four Planned rows (about 3,551 MW, planned operation 2031-2033) plus a 500 MW row in Canceled or Postponed.
Capacity can differ from agency figures: Revolution Wind 715 MW here vs 'estimated capacity of 704 megawatts' on the BOEM page.
Coordinates are one point per plant (offshore points sit in the lease area), not a project boundary; no wind row fell outside the US bounding box.
Operating sheet holds 1,581 wind rows (about 166,942 MW): do not mix it with Planned.

problems: Landing page lists October, November and December 2026 XLS links, but those URLs redirect to /electricity/ and return HTML (55,942 bytes) instead of a workbook; the latest downloadable month was September 2026.

evidence.quote: The monthly survey Form EIA-860M, Monthly Update to Annual Electric Generator Report supplements the annual survey form EIA-860 data with monthly information that monitors the current status of existing and proposed generating units at electric power plants with 1 megawatt or greater of combined nameplate capacity.
Estimates will be corrected without specific acknowledgment or explanation in subsequent month's inventory.

steps: POST the form above for the Renewable Energy program GUID (8be74528-2bea-f011-8544-001dd80f931d); page with page=N and length=50 until an empty data array (485 rows on 2026-11-19, 485 distinct NEPA numbers).
Keep rows whose projectname contains 'wind' (32 rows: 17 CE, 8 EIS, 5 EA, 2 DNA; 22 Completed, 9 Cancelled/Withdrawn, 1 In Progress).
Open https://eplanning.blm.gov/Project-Home/?id=<projectid> for Applicant, county, start/decision/ROD dates and the narrative (MW is often only in the description text).
Treat only 'In Progress' rows as pending; read the decision document or notices before calling anything authorised.
reading_traps: 'Completed - Completed' is the NEPA process state: Lava Ridge shows ROD 12/4/2024 and the same page carries a later DOI statement on cancelling that approval.

Coordinates exist on only 15 of the 32 wind-named rows; MW is not a structured field.
Project 'Documents' and 'Map Data' tables (with release dates) load by script and were not retrievable with curl.
The /searchresults/ endpoint is the portal's own, not a documented API, and may change.

problems: No API documentation found for /searchresults/; it is the endpoint the public search page calls.

if_unstructured.summary: Stage dates, applicants and approvals sit in agency project pages and documents, not in the national list. Build the list from EIA-860M, then confirm each project in the agency record that has jurisdiction.
recipe: Download the latest EIA-860M workbook, read sheet 'Planned' and keep Energy Source Code WND; group rows by plant to get MW, state/county, coordinates and the status code (tested: 77 rows in the 2026-09 file).
Match each plant by name to the jurisdiction record: BLM NEPA Register (federal land), BOEM project page and layers (offshore) or the state siting body (tested for New York ORES).

Read applicant, decision or approval dates from the record page (tested with Lava Ridge, Revolution Wind, North Country Wind) and note which document type each date belongs to (ROD, COP approval, permit, filing).
Report the project as in permitting only if the agency record shows an open review, an application or approval without construction; keep EIA-only rows as leads.
if_unstructured.location_method: Use EIA plant latitude/longitude; for offshore use BOEM phase-area polygons; for BLM use the search-result coordinates when present; for state portals use the town/county in the description (administrative precision only).
if_unstructured.cross_with: Plant Name in EIA-860M with project names in BLM, BOEM and ORES; BOEM lease number with BOEM phase-area layer; ORES matter number with DMM matter number.
